meta.title: Photographer & Full-Stack Developer
meta.description: Elroe Fikremariam is a photographer and full-stack web developer. See selected photography, websites, and what is coming next.

hero.tagline: I make images and build the websites they live on.

about.label: About
paragraphs: I'm Elroe — a photographer and full-stack web developer. I care about the same things in both: light, composition, and the small details most people only feel.
With a camera, that means patient, honest images. With code, it means websites that load fast, read clearly and work on every screen — built end to end.

services.title: Photography
services.text: Images made with patience and edited with restraint, delivered ready to print or post.

services.title: Web development
services.text: Full-stack websites, from the first sketch to a live site that is fast, responsive and easy to manage.

photography.label: Photography

development.nextText: More projects are on the way. If you need a website, the next one here could be yours.
